# Pinned upstream source

Project: codex-finder 0.1.2 by milisp.
Original repository: https://github.com/milisp/codex-finder
Commit: `fbfa841e465af96ec681704531766fe88cc895fc`.
License: MIT; complete original terms are in LICENSE.

The original repository was publicly unavailable when building Codex Lemma on 2026-10-24.
These source files, package metadata, example and README are byte-for-byte copies of
the commit already pinned by Lemma's Cargo.lock, recovered from its existing Cargo checkout.
Upstream CI, .gitignore and its standalone lockfile are omitted. No upstream code was changed.
SHA256SUMS.json records the original file contents. This dependency remains outside Lemma's
workspace; its own 0.1.2 version and license remain unchanged.
